spec.prompt: The spherical Voskhod-2 capsule under its parachute drops toward snowy fir treetops; at the last moment its soft-landing rockets fire with a burst of flame and snow, and it crashes down between two tall firs into deep snow, snow exploding up in a white cloud, branches whipping. Low angle from the snow. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
